question: The wrestler must be at least _______ years old, and must be sponsored by the national federation, to compete at the World Championships or Olympic Games.
solution:
The correct answer is __**17**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The minimum age for a wrestler to compete at the World Championships or Olympic Games is 17 years.
 
• Wrestlers must be sponsored by their national federation to participate in these events.
 
• This age requirement is set by international wrestling bodies such as United World Wrestling (UWW).
 
• Allowing younger athletes to compete helps in identifying and nurturing talent at an early age.
